purpose: Strict anti-triviality, anti-mode-collapse, and shortcut prevention boundaries for the V6.2 dataset.

maximum_single_cluster_share.v6_2_mechanism: Eliminated global commercial/transit hub lists in favor of district-local role portfolios; Cluster 7 Connaught Place localized to NEW_DELHI only.

maximum_fraud_cluster_concentration.v6_2_mechanism: Decoupled fraud types from specific cluster IDs; fraud types map to functional role preferences dispersed across all 11 districts.

conditions: No single cluster probability may equal 1.0
No single district probability may equal 1.0
Every candidate cluster in realized district retains positive probability support

anti_gaming_rules.no_post_generation_quotas: The generator must NOT enforce hard artificial caps by pruning or reassigning rows post-generation.
anti_gaming_rules.no_benchmark_rejection_sampling: The generator must NOT reject generated cases based on whether they improve learnability or anti-triviality metrics.
anti_gaming_rules.organic_probability_generation: All pass/fail metrics must be the natural outcome of the generative probabilistic distribution.
